conflicts.description: Files are already modified in the worktree, so implementation must inspect current content immediately before patching and avoid overwriting concurrent WIP.
conflicts.impact: Use minimal patches around income normalization helpers and tests only.

conflicts.description: Tax export merges BONUS and EXGRATIA, while Daftar Upah can expose EXGRATIA as a separate dynamic income type. This explains double/split columns and mismatched totals.
conflicts.impact: Introduce one canonical income category resolver used by extractor and exports.

conflicts.description: Tax report de-dupes by emp_code first, which can keep duplicate rows when one person has old/new emp_code for the same NIK.
conflicts.impact: Use report identity NIK/new_nik before emp_code where available, and test row count.
